description_md: **Unofficial extension — not FinOps Foundation vocabulary.** The official FinOps Maturity Model defines three levels: Crawl, Walk, and Run. This server adds `pre-crawl` to describe the state *below* Crawl: the capability's Crawl-level characteristics are not yet met consistently (little or no process, tooling, or shared understanding). No official assessment content exists below Crawl; use the Crawl characteristics as the target when assessing a pre-crawl capability.
title: Pre-Crawl (unofficial extension)
